Program.metaTitle: English Programs for Kids: Kindy, Intro, Secondary
Program.metaDescription: Three English levels for children aged 4–15: Kindy, Intro and Secondary. Step-by-step conversation and grammar with the same curriculum at every BEC unit.

hero.title: BEC Programs
hero.lead: A real English course — conversation and grammar from the basics to fluency, split into three levels by age. Every BEC unit uses the same curriculum.

why.title: Fun Learning, Measurable Results
why.lead: Every unit uses the same method, so class quality stays consistent wherever your child learns.
why.conversationText: Children start speaking from the very first class.
why.grammarText: From the basics to fluency, matched to each level.
why.classText: Teachers can pay attention to every child.
why.reportText: Parents get regular updates on their child's progress.

compare.title: Compare the Three Levels
compare.lead: See the differences at a glance and pick the level that best fits your child's age and skills.
compare.caption: Comparison of the Kindy, Intro and Secondary levels

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Not answered here? Ask your nearest unit directly on WhatsApp.
faq.askText: The BEC admin is happy to help you choose the right level for your child.

Partnership.metaTitle: Partnership — Open a Kids' English Course Unit
Partnership.metaDescription: Open a BEC kids' English course unit at home. Curriculum, training and support are ready. Check your village quota (max. 2 units per village) and apply online.

hero.title: Open a Kids' English Course Unit at Home
hero.lead: Turn your living room into a fun place to learn that helps your village. BEC prepares the curriculum, training and mentoring — you focus on guiding the children.

benefits.title: Everything You Need Is Ready
benefits.lead: Start without building materials from scratch. You get a system already used in hundreds of BEC classes.

curriculum.title: Ready-to-use curriculum
curriculum.text: Kindy, Intro and Secondary modules with lesson plans for every meeting.

training.title: Training & mentoring
training.text: Teaching-method training for you and your teachers, plus regular mentoring.

marketing.title: Marketing kit
marketing.text: Ready-made brochure, banner and social-media designs.

system.title: Admin system
system.text: Student enrolment and clear progress reports for parents.

brand.title: A trusted brand
brand.text: Parents already know BEC, so your new unit earns trust faster.

territory.title: Protected area
territory.text: At most 2 units per village, so every unit has enough prospective students.

fit.title: No English Literature Degree Needed
fit.lead: What matters most is loving children and being willing to learn. BEC partners come from many backgrounds.
